$comment: One device set one way, by the iOS app: a step of the master button, or what the chat asks the app to switch (apps/ios/AquaTomeKit/Sources/Tanks/DeviceCommand.swift). The device is its record's id on the reader's tanks (tanks.schema.json). protocols/device-command-vectors.json has a case for each rule.

device.description: The device record's id: a plug (kind plug, brand tuya) or the Love Ecology lamp (kind light, brand loveecology).

outlet.description: A plug's outlet, its switch code (the record's outlets[].code). Absent for the lamp.

colour.description: The lamp turned on, in one of its recorded colours. Absent: it comes on as it was (asked by the chat: in the master button's colour).

SwitchResult.description: How one command went: done (a plug reported the state asked for; the lamp's command went out, it answers nothing), or not, with why in a line shown as it is.
